subject: int
title: (R)INT.------CULT.INFO.F.
description: Chart on book p. 159 (UPB(II)-21). INT (intention) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) is the partner. The line from the subject runs to RT-OP (reality options), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", at a bend, and from there to CULT-INFO-F. From RT-OP: ACT-T (actual terms). INFO-DE (information degrees) is on a dashed line from ACT-T. From CULT-INFO-F: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: ACT-TR (actual transformation), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
